en: The image shows a black-and-white, likely early 20th-century photograph of a settlement or institutional complex with several large, low buildings featuring gabled roofs and symmetrical windows. The foreground includes trees and some foliage, with a clear view over the complex. In the distance, a church spire is visible, suggesting a European setting. A large black rectangle obscures the lower center portion of the image, possibly masking sensitive information or damage. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the postcard.
